gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Lumary's Pro, Pro Max and Ultra gimbals put the radio in an 'Independent Control Box' that Lumary says 'boosts signal strength'. That matters because these lights are installed inside a ceiling.
standout_why: I couldn't open any rival page to compare against. Every lumarysmart.com, lumaryusa.com and cloudybaylighting.com page I tried returned HTTP 429, three times each. The Best Buy pages timed out, Walmart showed a bot check, Wayfair returned 429, and Amazon blocked amzcheck. The most decisive mechanism is that the lights need constant power, so a standard wall dimmer won't work, and they join 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only. ChatGPT's own answer already says this ('need constant power and aren't designed for traditional dimmer switches', '2.4 GHz Wi-Fi'), so it isn't new, and I couldn't open a page that states it. The control-box detail is the only mechanism fact I could open, and I can't confirm whether the cited Lumary product pages also mention it. That is why it scores 1 and not 2.
decides: It only weakly supports the RGB Gimbal Ultra, and maybe the Pro line, over the basic 9 W 'Standard' gimbal for installs where Wi-Fi reaches the ceiling poorly. Lumary's 2024 press release lists a signal-boosting separate control box for Pro, Pro Max and Ultra and lists none for Standard. It doesn't change which product the page picks. Caution: the 2024 names don't match today's catalog. The release gives 'Pro' as 355° rotation and 20° tilt, which matches today's 6-inch RGBWW gimbal, not the 90°-tilt RGBAI Gimbal Pro we list. Only 'Ultra' (270° rotation, 90° tilt) clearly matches a product on our page.

findings.product: Lumary Smart Gimbal Recessed Light Pro / Pro Max / Ultra (2024 series)
findings.label: Where the radio sits and what it's for
findings.value: Pro, Pro Max and Ultra each have an 'Independent Control Box'. Lumary's wording: Pro 'Significantly boosts signal strength', Pro Max 'Enhances signal strength', Ultra 'Boosts signal strength'.
findings.source_title: Introducing Lumary's New Smart Gimbal Recessed Light Series (PR Newswire, New York, Aug. 2, 2024)
findings.note: Lumary's own press release, republished. It lists no control box for the Standard or Plus models.

findings.product: Lumary Smart Gimbal Recessed Light series (2024)
findings.label: Aiming range by model, as Lumary named them in 2024
findings.value: Standard: '40° rotation'. Plus: 360° rotation, 90° tilt. Pro: 355° rotation, 20° tilt. Pro Max: 270° rotation, 90° tilt. Ultra: 270° rotation, 90° tilt.
findings.source_title: Introducing Lumary's New Smart Gimbal Recessed Light Series (PR Newswire, New York, Aug. 2, 2024)
findings.note: The aiming is manual. The release states Alexa and Google Assistant voice support for the Pro and names no Wi-Fi band, Matter, hub or dimmer rules for any model. The 2024 'Pro' (20° tilt) is not today's RGBAI Gimbal Pro (90° tilt).
